---
name: "Design or research proposal"
about: "Compare options and make an unresolved decision reviewable."
title: "[Proposal] "
---

## Problem and scope

Who benefits, what is excluded, and what decision is needed?

## Evidence and alternatives

Link inspectable sources, access/publication dates where relevant, reuse terms,
uncertainty, and conflicting evidence. Compare at least one smaller alternative.

## Proposed direction

Explain tradeoffs, worldwide interoperability, accessibility, privacy, and data
portability. Identify country-specific assumptions or external dependencies.

## Review and validation

Link related issues, PRs, and an ADR if warranted. Give acceptance criteria or an
experiment, and list unresolved questions. A proposal is not an accepted decision.

<!-- Keep governing rules, compensation, licenses, and authoritative charter text
explicitly separate from implementation proposals. Do not invent approval bodies. -->
